# Git Base-Branch Requirements Checklist: Task branches start from a fresh default branch

**Purpose**: Test the spec's requirements on base-branch selection, fetching and failure behaviour before planning (reviewer).
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is it specified which repos are updated for each project type and mode (repo; parent worktree; parent checkout, where the parent folder gets no branch)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the base defined for the parent's own worktree as well as for each chosen submodule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the fallback order defined when the update fails (last known remote default → local default → current commit)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the case "remote declares no default branch" covered, both online and offline? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 - Is it specified where the start warning appears and how long it stays (task screen, Bandeja, dismissable or not)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 - Is it specified what the daemon records about the base for diagnosis? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is "bounded time" in FR-008 quantified, and is it clear whether the limit applies per repo or to the whole start? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK008 - Is "the remote" unambiguously named (which remote of a repo with several)? [Clarity, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "existing task branch" defined per repo (a submodule may have it while another does not)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 - Is FR-005 (use an existing branch as is) consistent with worktree mode, where an existing branch makes the start fail today and FR-011 says failures stay as today? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK011 - Do SC-003 (offline start ≤ 30 s slower) and US4-2 (held up at most the time limit) state the same limit for a parent with several submodules? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, US4]
- [x] CHK012 - Is FR-006 (no change to the project folder) consistent with checkout mode, where the folder's checked-out branch does change by design? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, US2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 - Can SC-001 ("contains every commit on the remote's default branch at the moment the task was started") be verified objectively with fixtures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 - Is SC-002 (no rebase needed) measurable, given it depends on later merges? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK015 - Are requirements defined for a backlog task started later (the base is taken at start, not at backlog creation)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK016 - Are concurrent starts of two tasks of the same project addressed by a requirement, not only an edge-case note? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the partial-failure path in a parent project (one submodule fails to update) specified? [Coverage, Exception Flow, US4-3]
- [x] CHK018 - Is it stated that a fetch failure never rolls back or aborts the start (no recovery path needed beyond the existing one)? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Are no-remote, credential prompt, local-ahead-of-remote and dirty-checkout cases each addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 - Is a chosen submodule with no remote (or a `file://` remote, as in the fixtures) covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK021 - Is the added start latency online bounded (SC-004) and is "a few seconds" acceptable as a criterion? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK022 - Is it specified that updates never prompt and run with the agent-free environment the daemon already uses for git? [Security, Spec §FR-008]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 - Is the decision not to fast-forward local `main` recorded with its reason? [Assumption]
- [x] CHK024 - Is per-project base-branch configuration explicitly out of scope? [Assumption]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the interaction with Spec Kit's branch creation stated? [Dependency, Assumptions]

## Notes

- First pass found gaps in CHK001, CHK005, CHK007, CHK009, CHK010, CHK011, CHK012,
  CHK016, CHK020 and CHK022; the spec was updated (FR-001, FR-004a, FR-005,
  FR-006, FR-007, FR-008, FR-012, SC-003, US4-2) and every item now passes.
